scripts.setup: npm install && npm run copy-alpine && npm run build
scripts.copy-alpine: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('./static/js',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('./node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js','./static/js/alpine.min.js'); console.log('Alpine.js copiado a static/js/');"
